faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Tirupati Research Associate position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Research Associate position at IIT Tirupati is 14th September 2026. Ensure all details are accurate before the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Research Associate role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a PhD in Quantum Computation or a closely related discipline with proven expertise in the Quantum computing domain. Those who have submitted their PhD thesis are also eligible.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Research Associate position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Research Associate position is 35 years. Age relaxation will be provided to candidates belonging to reserved categories as per the institute's norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Research Associate post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 58,000, plus applicable House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q5. Is there an application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the Research Associate position?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Research Associate position at IIT Tirupati.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Research Associate role?
faq.answer: The selection process involves an initial screening based on qualification and experience, followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The Research Associate position is a contractual role at IIT Tirupati.

faq.question: Q9. Where is IIT Tirupati located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology Tirupati is located in Tirupati, Andhra Pradesh, with the pincode 517619.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates who have submitted their PhD thesis apply?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates who have submitted their PhD thesis in a relevant area are eligible to apply for the Research Associate position.
